visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width background image with a white rounded card holding a heading, text and a link
visualCharacteristics.layout: Card overlaid left-center on desktop; stacked below the image on mobile

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image; row 2 = heading (e.g. H3), paragraph, link

usage: Find a dealer teaser over a map image.
reuseGuidance: Use for teaser bands where text sits in a boxed card over a still image. For video backgrounds use hero-video.
